result: Pinned-source inspection refines worker198: Peer<RoleClient>::call_tool_once itself still has no explicit local tasks-capability precondition and maps ServerResult::CreateTaskResult to CallToolResponse::Task. But the same rust-sdk commit enforces the capability at server dispatch: ServerHandler::handle_request rejects CallToolResponse::Task for ClientRequest::CallToolRequest when the client/request capabilities do not declare the tasks extension, returning Missing Required Client Capability. The exact-commit end-to-end test dispatch_rejects_task_result_for_non_declaring_client confirms the -32021 rejection. Therefore task capability enforcement exists in this path, but it is server-dispatch enforcement rather than an explicit caller-side call_tool_once precondition.
